titles.en: Stele of Lushan Temple, original stone

dimensions.raw: 高 272 厘米，宽 133 厘米，圆顶
dimensions.note: 28 lines of 56 characters; about 1400 characters originally.

currentCollection.note: Stands in the protective pavilion at Yuelu Academy; the pavilion was built in 1962 according to the same page.
currentCollection.noteZh: 立于岳麓书院护碑亭内；该页称护碑亭建于 1962 年。

provenanceEvents.summary: Mi Fu visited to study the stele and left a sixteen-character inscription on its reverse.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 米芾前来临习，并在碑阴留下十六字题名。

review.note: Draft object record from a local-history page. The fracture history is summarized in one clause.
review.noteZh: 依据地方志平台页面整理的草稿；断裂经过仅一句带过。

notes: The page gives dimensions, line count, and an approximate surviving character count, but no condition survey.
The page states that the stone cracked and lost text, without dating the damage.
The cutter is named as 黄仙鹤, whom scholars suspect to be the author’s alias; no separate cutter is asserted.
notesZh: 页面给出尺寸、行款与约略存字，但没有保存状况调查。
页面称碑石断裂、文字残损，但没有说明损坏年代。
刻者署「黄仙鹤」，学界疑为撰书者化名，故不单列刻者。
